title: Defining and Detecting Toxicity on Social Media: Context and Knowledge are Key

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating semantic ambiguity and false positive rates in extremism detection by comparing term usage (e.g., "jihad") across a curated corpus of verified extremist users and a balanced distractor corpus of non-extremist Muslim users.
Curating and analyzing an age-specific dataset (ALONE corpus) of high school student network interactions to disambiguate benign adolescent vernacular and teasing from actual toxic harassment.

Proposing a multi-dimensional, knowledge-infused learning framework to resolve linguistic ambiguity and context-dependent slang that varies across different social and cultural groups, evaluating how standard algorithms fail to generalize across populations.
